description: 3-stage mass assignment via GORM pointer-to-fix-zero-value pattern: (1) add IsActive bool and IsRestricted bool fields to Account model with json:"-" tags for internal status tracking + GET /api/v1/accounts/:id/status admin endpoint, (2) add PUT /api/v1/accounts/:id endpoint using db.Updates(&account) for field updates -- but GORM ignores Go zero-values (false, 0, "") so users cannot set IsActive=false, (3) fix zero-value persistence by changing bool to *bool (pointer types) -- THE VULNERABILITY: IsRestricted was previously safe because zero-value false was ignored by Updates(), but pointer types make it mass-assignable.
